thread:
sarah-cs: Heads-up — Acme Health says a bunch of users show up in the org but they have no roles. They can log in, but get 403 when trying to access product routes. Customer sees SCIM user create OK (200) but role mappings never applied.

mike-identity: Can you paste the provisioning logs (SCIM responses) and the API error? also which token is the provisioning service using?

sarah-cs: Paste from customer (sanitized):
```
POST /scim/v2/Users -> 201
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/<g-id> -> 200
POST /internal/admin/orgs/acme/users/<u-id>/assign-role -> 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope"}
```
They said this started after a token rotation last week. Token name on their side: redwood-provisioner-2026.

raj-platform: That 403 with insufficient_scope smells like the token used for the post-provision step doesn't have the role assignment scope. We rotated a subset of service tokens in infra on 2026-02-28 — possible mismatch if customer cached older token metadata. Can you confirm the token scopes used by the provisioning job?

sarah-cs: I asked customer to send the value of the Authorization header (they redacted) and the token ID; they confirmed it's the rotated token. They also sent an audit line from our audit service: 
```
2026-03-16T12:01:03Z service=provisioner token_id=rt-abc123 scopes="scim:read scim:write" action=assign-role org=acme result=403
```

mike-identity: There it is — token only has scim scopes, not role assign scope. Role assignment endpoint requires scope `roles:write` (we added that scope last year). Looks like the provisioning job wasn't reconfigured to request the new scope during rotation.

raj-platform: Quick mitigation: create a short-lived one-off token with `scim:read scim:write roles:write` and ask Acme to swap it in their provisioner, then re-run the backfill. For the permanent fix we should update our token-rotation runbook and add a verification step that the token has `roles:write` when creating service tokens for provisioning.

mike-identity: Agreed. Also add a small endpoint check in our onboarding script that does: `POST /internal/admin/orgs/<org>/users/<user>/assign-role` as smoke test. If 403, abort and surface clearer error.

sarah-cs: I told Acme the workaround and they want our help doing the backfill because they don't want to risk doing it themselves. Can someone from platform volunteer to run the backfill?

raj-platform: I can take it. I need the org ID and a list of affected group externalIds. Also confirm whether group externalId normalization might be a factor (we've seen trailing whitespace in some SAML group names). If externalId mismatch, we should remap before assigning roles.

sarah-cs: Sending org id and sample group externalIds in DM. Action items: 1) raj to run backfill with temp token (P0), 2) mike to update rotation runbook and add smoke-test, 3) product docs update to call out `roles:write` required for SCIM provisioning flows.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: token-rotation-service v2.14.3 -> prod (sha: d4f9c8). No incidents.

mike-identity: I'll own the runbook PR and add the smoke-test; will ping when merged.

raj-platform: Backfill started at 2026-03-16T15:10Z, applying role assignments for ~278 users. I'll post a short report when done.

sarah-cs: Thanks team — keeping Acme updated now.
